newsitem.title: ITALY: PRESS DIGEST - Italy - Monday July 7.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Italy - Monday July 7.

text.p: Following are some of the top headlines in leading Italian newspapers.

* European Union finance ministers are expected to examine on Monday Italy's latest efforts to join a single currency, yet they would probably hold back final judgement until a 1998 budget plan is put firmly into place. Today's Ecofin meeting is likely to give credit to the country's centre-left government for outlining a realistic economic convergence programme that stretches until the year 2000 (all).

* State rail company Ferrovie dello Stato needs public or private financing otherwise the giant risks collapse. In spite of the fact that Italy's railway system is the busiest in Europe, Gianfranco Cimoli, the group's managing director, said the company's deficit would rise to five trillion lire in 1997 against 3.5 trillion last year (La Repubblica, Affari&Finanza).
Reuters has not verified these stories and cannot vouch for their accuracy.
